body_en: Donald Trump also defended his commerce secretary Howard Lutnick today, after he came under fire for allegedly slow-walking export restrictions on Nvidia chips to China. This comes after the company’s CEO, Jensen Huang, was ousted from his role following a revelation that he had a close relationship with Alice Huang (no relation), allegedly a Chinese operative.

Lutnick is now set to testify before Congress about delays by the commerce department in adding Singapore-based Megaspeed, which is associated with Alice Huang and has bought billions of dollars of Nvidia chips in recent years, to Washington’s blacklist of companies that the US considers a risk to national security despite reported concerns within the administration.

Today, Trump justified any delayed action by Lutnick, adding that he’s done a “very good” job. “If you didn’t delay it, if you did do something, you could have a blow up with China. We’re having a very good relationship with China right now,” Trump said.
Lutnick is currently traveling with the president and other senior officials and cabinet members to Manila.

Meanwhile, Scott Bessent , Trump’s treasury secretary, said in an intervie with CNBC that he has “for months” been in favor of putting Megaspeed on the blacklist – but Lutnick’s commerce department “has the pen”.
“You will have to ask them about their internal process,” he added on Friday.
Today, Trump said he understood both officials’ perspectives.
“One wants to be friendly with China and one wants to have a blowup with China. They both are acceptable but they are different views,” the president told reporters.

title_en: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks
title_zh: 加州因黑客风险起诉 OpenAI
summary: The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.
summary_zh: 该州总检察长在 Hugging Face 攻击后开始调查 OpenAI，现在表示，由于 Ope，这次攻击“完全可以预见”
body_en: California sues OpenAI over hacking risks The state's attorney general started investigating OpenAI after the Hugging Face attack and now says this attack was "entirely foreseeable" due to OpenAI's poor security practices.

California Attorney General Rob Bonta announced a lawsuit against OpenAI on Monday Nov. 16, 2026. In the complaint, California alleged that OpenAI misled the public about how unsafe its products are. California Department of Justice/Screenshot by NPR hide caption
California Department of Justice/Screenshot by NPR

California sued OpenAI Monday, alleging that the frontier AI company failed to protect the public from its systems' advanced cyber capabilities. The lawsuit stems from OpenAI's agents' attack on open-source software platform Hugging Face over the summer but also touches on a wide range of other related incidents tied to the company's agents acting without authorization.

"Just because the technology is new or rapidly evolving doesn't mean the people behind it are above the law," said California Attorney General Rob Bonta during a press conference. "Whether it's a car or a toy, the law is simple: don't build or test things that can hurt people without proper safeguards." The lawsuit cited potential concerns about cyberattacks "on power grids, emergency infrastructure, hospital systems, and financial institutions."
Why did OpenAI's and Anthropic's AI models hack other companies?

In the complaint , California alleged that OpenAI misled the public about how unsafe its products are. The state said the company admitted to the attorney general's office that "it lost control of its autonomous AI agents over 80 times during testing."

That number is higher than what OpenAI has so far disclosed publicly and more than what outside researchers have independently discovered, but OpenAI has otherwise provided little information, California said. The state also accused OpenAI of poor security practices, stonewalling the state's investigation into the company and discouraging employees from speaking up about safety.

In a statement to NPR, OpenAI spokesperson Drew Pusateri said the lawsuit "appears to single out OpenAI over a challenge that's been identified by every major AI lab" and that the company has "engaged—and will continue to engage—constructively with the Attorney General's office to share information and advance strong, practical safety standards for the entire industry."
Fired OpenAI employees question the company's commitment to safety

After the most notorious of cyber incidents involving OpenAI's agents – the attack on Hugging Face over the summer – the company admitted that it did not monitor its agents in ways its own researchers deemed important. Since then, outside researchers as well as OpenAI itself have found more incidents in which AI agents have interacted with websites and communicated with each other on the internet in ways that OpenAI did not intend. The lawsuit mentions these events as well as other incidents that OpenAI started disclosing voluntarily to the public.

Other AI companies have also had to wrestle with their systems behaving in unexpected and undesirable ways. Anthropic and Meta have both said they found that their AI systems have hacked into places they shouldn't have. Major AI companies have since signed onto an agreement organized by the White House to develop AI responsibly, but the agreement is nonbinding.

Drawing from reports including from OpenAI's own disclosures, California alleges that the top AI company has engaged in unfair competition and created a public nuisance. It asked the court to stop the company from further engaging in such activities and order it to pay monetary damages.

body_zh: 加州因黑客风险起诉 OpenAI 该州总检察长在 Hugging Face 攻击后开始调查 OpenAI，现在表示，由于 OpenAI 的安全实践不佳，这次攻击“完全可以预见”。
加州总检察长 Rob Bonta 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日星期一宣布对 OpenAI 提起诉讼。在诉状中，加州指控 OpenAI 在其产品的不安全性方面误导公众。加州司法部/NPR 截图隐藏标题栏
加州司法部/NPR 截图
加州周一起诉 OpenAI，指控这家前沿人工智能公司未能保护公众免受其系统先进网络功能的影响。该诉讼源于 OpenAI 代理在今年夏天对开源软件平台 Hugging Face 的攻击，但也涉及与该公司代理未经授权行事有关的一系列其他相关事件。
加州总检察长罗布·邦塔 (Rob Bonta) 在新闻发布会上表示：“仅仅因为这项技术是新技术或快速发展，并不意味着其背后的人就可以凌驾于法律之上。” “无论是汽车还是玩具，法律都很简单：不要在没有适当保障措施的情况下制造或测试可能伤害他人的东西。”该诉讼提到了对“电网、应急基础设施、医院系统和金融机构”网络攻击的潜在担忧。
为什么 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的人工智能模型会攻击其他公司？
在诉状中，加州指控 OpenAI 在其产品的不安全性方面误导公众。该州表示，该公司向总检察长办公室承认，“在测试过程中，其自主人工智能代理失去控制超过 80 次”。
加州表示，这个数字高于 OpenAI 迄今为止公开披露的数字，也高于外部研究人员独立发现的数字，但 OpenAI 提供的信息很少。该州还指责 OpenAI 的安全措施不佳，阻碍了该州对该公司的调查，并阻止员工谈论安全问题。
OpenAI 发言人 Drew Pusateri 在给 NPR 的一份声明中表示，这起诉讼“似乎针对 OpenAI 提出了每个主要人工智能实验室都已确定的挑战”，并且该公司“已经并将继续与总检察长办公室进行建设性的接触，以共享信息并为整个行业推进强大、实用的安全标准。”
被解雇的 OpenAI 员工质疑公司对安全的承诺
在涉及 OpenAI 代理的最臭名昭著的网络事件（今年夏天对 Hugging Face 的攻击）之后，该公司承认，它没有以自己的研究人员认为重要的方式监控其代理。此后，外部研究人员以及 OpenAI 本身发现了更多 AI 代理以 OpenAI 不希望的方式与网站交互并在互联网上相互通信的事件。该诉讼提到了这些事件以及 OpenAI 开始自愿向公众披露的其他事件。
其他人工智能公司也不得不努力解决其系统以意想不到的和不良的方式运行的问题。 Anthropic 和 Meta 都表示，他们发现他们的人工智能系统侵入了他们不应该侵入的地方。此后，主要的人工智能公司签署了一份由白宫组织的协议，以负责任的方式开发人工智能，但该协议不具有约束力。
根据 OpenAI 自己披露的报告，加州指控这家顶级人工智能公司从事不公平竞争并造成公共滋扰。请求法院停止该公司进一步从事此类活动，并责令其支付经济损失。

body_en: DoJ warns Elizabeth Warren of ‘consequences’ unless she preserves Trump records | Elizabeth Warren
Letter to Warren, likely to chair Senate banking committee, echoes warnings to Democrats moving to investigate Trump

The Trump administration has warned Elizabeth Warren , the senior Democratic senator expected to chair the powerful Senate banking committee, she could face “significant legal consequences” if she fails to preserve records related to investigations into Donald Trump .

US attorney Aaron Reitz of the southern district of Texas sent Warren a warning letter, stating that she appears “eager to wield your future gavel like a tomahawk, hunting for the scalps of President Trump’s private associates”.

The letter mirrors other warnings that Department of Justice officials have sent to Democratic lawmakers who have indicated they will investigate the Trump administration when the party becomes the majority in Congress next year.
Chris Van Hollen says he has path to win Senate leader over Chuck Schumer

A top White House lawyer warned Robert Garcia , the congressman expected to lead the oversight committee of the House of Representatives, last week that the administration was “monitoring” Democrats’ potential congressional investigations, claiming some of the inquiries could amount to criminal action.
Democratic lawmakers have long called for investigations into Trump, his administration and those close to him, accusing individuals of corruption.
After winning back the House and Senate in the 2026 midterms , Democrats poised to take top roles on congressional committees have signaled they will begin investigating some of those people.

Warren and other lawmakers recently sent a letter to Meredith O’Rourke, a top Trump fundraiser, asking that she preserve documents related to potential funding for the White House ballroom, among other projects.
While no formal investigation has been launched, notices to preserve records are typically a sign of an incoming investigation.

Earlier this month, Warren told CBS News’s Face the Nation : “If you’ve been making your profits by cheating American families and scamming your investors, you better get ready for some investigations, serious ones.”

Warren also wrote in an op-ed for Time : “With astonishing brazenness, Trump has attempted to reengineer the federal government into a corruption machine designed to rake in profits for himself, his family, and his cronies.”
The Guardian has asked Warren’s office for comment.

Reitz recently sent a similar letter to Senator Richard Blumenthal, the top Democrat on the homeland security and governmental affairs subcommittee, for sending letters to more than a dozen people who did not disclose donations for Trump’s White House ballroom project.

德克萨斯州南部地区的美国检察官亚伦·雷茨向沃伦发出了一封警告信，称她似乎“渴望像战斧一样挥舞你未来的木槌，寻找特朗普总统私人助理的头皮”。

本月早些时候，沃伦对哥伦比亚广播公司新闻节目《面对全国》表示：“如果你一直通过欺骗美国家庭和投资者来赚取利润，那么你最好准备好接受一些调查，而且是严肃的调查。”
沃伦还在《时代》杂志的一篇专栏文章中写道：“特朗普厚颜无耻地试图将联邦政府改造成一台腐败机器，旨在为他自己、他的家人和他的亲信攫取利润。”

body_en: Up First briefing: FAA ground stop; Dems in Congress; Trump in Asia : NPR

Up First briefing: FAA ground stop; Dems in Congress; Trump in Asia U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that things could be back to normal at the end of Monday after an FAA ground stop disrupted flights. And, Trump heads to Asia for a high-profile trilateral summit.
Your support helps make our show possible and unlocks access to our sponsor-free feed.
FAA Ground Stop Update, Democratic Leadership Contest, Trump's Travels To Asia

Travelers are expected to face continued disruptions at airports as airlines recover from Friday's nationwide ground stop. As of Sunday evening, more than 2,300 flights have been canceled , and more than 8,000 flights within, into or out of the U.S. have been delayed, according to FlightAware.com. Dallas-Fort Worth and Atlanta airports saw the most disruptions, with over 250 delayed flights each. U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said L3Harris Technologies Inc., a federal contractor, was doing routine maintenance in at least one remote location, changing copper wire to fiber optics.

Aircraft are seen at Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport in Arlington, Va., Saturday, Nov. 14, 2026, after the Federal Aviation Administration grounded flights nationwide. Tom Brenner/AP hide caption

🎧 The U.S. air traffic system remains safe , and this recent incident is considered an unusual meltdown, NPR's Joel Rose tells Up First . The Federal Aviation Administration believes it has identified the issue, and airlines will be ready for the holiday travel rush. Rose says the nation's air traffic system has suffered from decades of underinvestment by Congress and administrations from both parties. Before the ground stop, Duffy had requested $30 billion to upgrade the air traffic control system. Now he seems to be asking for $50 billion by the end of the year, on top of the $12.5 billion for air traffic equipment that the Trump administration secured from Congress last year. Democrats, who will control Congress in January, are not responding positively to Duffy's latest request. Rose expects Democrats to seek more clarity on the administration's spending and the causes of the ground stop.

As Democrats gear up for substantial majorities in Congress , one question looms: who will take the helm? So far, no one has challenged Rep. Hakeem Jeffries for the House speaker role. Meanwhile, Sen. Chris Van Hollen of Maryland is setting his sights on unseating longtime leader Chuck Schumer in the Senate.

🎧 A wave of incoming senators has spent months hearing voters demand change in Washington. NPR's Eric McDaniel says this presents a real opportunity for Van Hollen and a potential risk for Schumer , especially after the recent election results. Van Hollen needs 30 Democrats to secure a simple majority. He has support he needs from popular progressives like Bernie Sanders, and incoming members like Abdul El-Sayed and Peggy Flanagan, McDaniel says. Since votes are cast by secret ballot, it's uncertain how many will back each leader when they convene in a few weeks, and McDaniel says anything could happen.

President Trump is traveling to the Philippines and China this morning for a high-profile trip , which includes a trilateral summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin. This marks Trump's second visit to China this year. The trip to Asia comes as the administration faces scrutiny following Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation . Huang admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman linked to China's top spy agency, according to The New York Times . He traveled to China with Trump earlier this year; this time, tech billionaire Elon Musk is accompanying Trump to Shenzhen.

🎧 It's not unusual for presidents who face midterm election defeats to shift their focus to foreign policy, NPR's Mara Liasson says. But Trump's recent foreign policy efforts, including tariffs and the war in Iran, have been widely unpopular and seen as reasons why his party lost in the midterms, Liasson says. The White House said that Trump isn't expected to address pressing issues like the war in Ukraine or tensions with China during this trip. Instead, he plans to discuss the war in Iran and nuclear weapons. Trump will also skip mentioning Huang's affair. Bringing up the Nvidia situation could serve as a reminder that many in Congress believe the U.S. should restrict access to advanced chips in China. Trump disagrees with Congress on the matter, likely due to his ties with Huang, who committed millions of dollars for Trump's ballroom, Liasson says.
Living Better is a special series about what it takes to stay healthy in America.

Sleep plays a crucial role in weight management. Studies have found that poor sleep can increase appetite and lead to overeating, making it harder to shed pounds. On the flip side, quality sleep might actually enhance your weight-loss efforts. One study found that participants in a year-long weight-loss program who enjoyed better sleep lost more weight and fat. So, prioritizing sleep could be your secret weapon in the journey to a healthy weight. Here's what researchers say
😴 While evidence linking more sleep to weight loss is limited, there is consistent science connecting insufficient sleep to weight gain.
😴 Lack of sleep increases activity in brain regions associated with pleasure and reward, making it harder to make good food choices.
😴 Not having enough sleep can disrupt circadian rhythms and reduce insulin sensitivity, encouraging fat storage and weight gain.

😴 The relationship between sleep and food goes both ways. Eating added sugars and saturated fats disrupts sleep and reduces deep sleep, while consuming fruits, vegetables and fiber improves sleep quality and decreases nighttime awakenings.

Route 66 is celebrating an incredible century as America's most iconic highway. Stretching across eight states — from the vibrant streets of Chicago to the sun-soaked shores of Santa Monica, Calif. — this legendary route invites you to embrace the spirit of adventure on the open road. Imagine cruising through vast plains, rolling prairies, stunning canyons and shimmering deserts. Along the way, you'll discover a mix of big cities, charming cow towns and ghost towns. Over the decades, Route 66 has inspired countless songs, been captured in books, been seen in artwork and been celebrated in Pixar's 2006 animated movie Cars . 🎧 美国空中交通系统仍然安全，最近发生的这起事件被认为是一次不寻常的崩溃，NPR 的乔尔·罗斯 (Joel Rose) 告诉 Up First。美国联邦航空管理局相信已经发现了这个问题，航空公司将为假期旅行高峰做好准备。罗斯表示，美国的空中交通系统因国会和两党政府数十年来投资不足而受到影响。在地面停留之前，达菲要求花费 300 亿美元来升级空​​中交通管制系统。现在，除了特朗普政府去年从国会获得的 125 亿美元空中交通设备资金外，他似乎还要求在今年年底前再拨款 500 亿美元。将于一月份控制国会的民主党人没有对达菲的最新要求作出积极回应。罗斯预计民主党将进一步澄清政府的支出和停工的原因。
随着民主党准备在国会获得绝大多数席位，一个问题浮现出来：谁将掌舵？到目前为止，还没有人挑战众议员哈基姆·杰弗里斯（Hakeem Jeffries）担任众议院议长一职。与此同时，马里兰州参议员克里斯·范·霍伦 (Chris Van Hollen) 的目标是推翻参议院长期领导人查克·舒默 (Chuck Schumer)。

🎧 一波即将上任的参议员花了几个月的时间听取选民对华盛顿变革的要求。 NPR 的埃里克·麦克丹尼尔表示，这对范·霍伦来说是一个真正的机会，但对舒默来说却是一个潜在的风险，特别是在最近的选举结果公布之后。范霍伦需要 30 名民主党人才能获得简单多数。麦克丹尼尔说，他需要伯尼·桑德斯等受欢迎的进步人士以及阿卜杜勒·赛义德和佩吉·弗拉纳根等新成员的支持。由于投票是通过无记名投票进行的，因此不确定在几周后召开的会议上有多少人会支持每位领导人，麦克丹尼尔说任何事情都有可能发生。
特朗普总统今天上午将前往菲律宾和中国进行一次备受瞩目的访问，其中包括与中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行三边峰会。这是特朗普今年第二次访华。这次亚洲之行正值英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋辞职后政府面临审查之际。据《纽约时报》报道，黄承认与一名与中国最高间谍机构有联系的女性有婚外情。今年早些时候，他与特朗普一起访问了中国。此次，科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克陪同特朗普前往深圳。

NPR 的玛拉·利亚森 (Mara Liasson) 表示，对于面临中期选举失败的总统来说，将注意力转向外交政策并不罕见。但利亚森表示，特朗普最近的外交政策努力，包括关税和伊朗战争，普遍不受欢迎，并被视为他的政党在中期选举中失败的原因。白宫表示，预计特朗普此行不会解决乌克兰战争或与中国的紧张局势等紧迫问题。相反，他计划讨论伊朗战争和核武器。特朗普也将跳过提及黄的事件。提起英伟达的情况可能会提醒人们，国会中的许多人认为美国应该限制中国获得先进芯片。利亚森说，特朗普在此事上与国会意见不一，这可能是因为他与黄的​​关系，黄为特朗普的舞厅投入了数百万美元。
《生活得更好》是一个关于如何在美国保持健康的特别系列。
睡眠在体重管理中起着至关重要的作用。研究发现，睡眠不足会增加食欲并导致暴饮暴食，从而使减肥变得更加困难。另一方面，优质睡眠实际上可能会增强您的减肥效果。一项研究发现，参加为期一年的减肥计划的参与者如果睡眠质量更好，体重和脂肪会减少更多。因此，优先考虑睡眠可能是您实现健康体重的秘密武器。这是研究人员的说法
😴 虽然将更多睡眠与减肥联系起来的证据有限，但有一致的科学证据表明睡眠不足与体重增加有关。
😴 睡眠不足会增加与快乐和奖励相关的大脑区域的活动，使人们更难做出好的食物选择。
😴睡眠不足会扰乱昼夜节律并降低胰岛素敏感性，从而促进脂肪储存和体重增加。
😴睡眠和食物之间的关系是双向的。吃添加糖和饱和脂肪会扰乱睡眠并减少深度睡眠，而吃水果、蔬菜和纤维则可以改善睡眠质量并减少夜间醒来。
2019年2月27日，加利福尼亚州莫哈韦沙漠安博伊附近的沥青上画着“66号公路”标志。Eric Baradat/

66 号公路作为美国最具标志性的高速公路正在庆祝一个令人难以置信的世纪。这条传奇路线横跨八个州——从芝加哥充满活力的街道到加利福尼亚州圣莫尼卡阳光普照的海岸——邀请您在开阔的道路上拥抱冒险精神。想象一下，巡航穿过广阔的平原、连绵起伏的大草原、令人惊叹的峡谷和闪闪发光的沙漠。一路上，您会发现大城市、迷人的牛镇和鬼城。几十年来，66 号公路激发了无数歌曲的灵感，被记录在书籍中、出现在艺术作品中，并在皮克斯 2006 年的动画电影《赛车总动员》中受到赞扬。因此，跳上车，系好安全带，通过这些照片体验 66 号公路的魔力。

title_en: Regulating AI will being a top priority for congressional Democrats in the new year
title_zh: 监管人工智能将成为国会民主党人新一年的首要任务
summary: A big priority for the incoming Congress will be regulating artificial intelligence. Democrats will face stiff opposition from the Trump administration and its hands-off policy towards AI.
summary_zh: 即将上任的国会的首要任务将是监管人工智能。民主党将面临特朗普政府的强烈反对
body_en: Regulating AI will being a top priority for congressional Democrats in the new year A big priority for the incoming Congress will be regulating artificial intelligence. Democrats will face stiff opposition from the Trump administration and its hands-off policy towards AI.
A big priority for the incoming Congress will be regulating artificial intelligence. Democrats will face stiff opposition from the Trump administration and its hands-off policy towards AI.

How to handle artificial intelligence is one of the big questions facing the new Democratic-led Congress beginning in January. As NPR's Katie McQue reports, lawmakers have ambitious plans, but the Trump administration may not like them.

KATIE MCQUE, BYLINE: President Trump has repeatedly said he wants the U.S. to beat China in the race to develop AI and that regulations could slow things down. Here's Trump at an event with tech CEOs in September.
PRESIDENT DONALD TRUMP: You're going to have a winner, or you're going to have a loser. We're leading now over China and everyone else, and I want to keep it that way.

MCQUE: Trump has rolled back Biden-era AI policies and has tried to stop states from making their own laws about AI. Yet there are concerns about the risks of increasingly powerful AI. Vermont Senator Bernie Sanders, an independent who caucuses with Democrats, told NPR he plans to introduce multiple AI bills next year.
BERNIE SANDERS: People are worried that AI will take their jobs, invade their privacy, impact the mental well-being of their children, impact our democratic foundations.

MCQUE: Sanders says he also wants a ban on developing super-intelligent forms of AI. Another issue is privacy. Democratic New York Congresswoman Yvette Clarke says she wants rules on how people's data can be used by AI companies.
YVETTE CLARKE: A lot of the challenges that we face is the invasive ways in which our data is being used without permission.
MCQUE: She hopes some Republicans will sign on to these bills.
CLARKE: I'm just hoping that when the dust settles, we have enough open-minded and fair-minded colleagues on the other side of the aisle to make our efforts bipartisan.

MCQUE: President Trump can veto any bills that Congress passes. While Sanders has doubts about Trump's fitness as a leader, he is optimistic that Trump may still be persuadable when it comes to AI safety.
SANDERS: He is not stupid, and he actually is a good politician. And he changes his mind every day.
MCQUE: Sanders says the public wants AI safeguards, and it's Congress' job to act.

即将上任的国会的首要任务将是监管人工智能。民主党将面临特朗普政府及其对人工智能不干涉政策的强烈反对。
如何处理人工智能是一月份开始的民主党领导的新国会面临的重大问题之一。正如美国国家公共广播电台 (NPR) 的凯蒂·麦奎 (Katie McQue) 报道的那样，立法者制定了雄心勃勃的计划，但特朗普政府可能不喜欢它们。
凯蒂·麦奎连线：特朗普总统一再表示，他希望美国在开发人工智能的竞赛中击败中国，而法规可能会减慢发展速度。这是特朗普在 9 月份与科技公司首席执行官举行的活动中的照片。
唐纳德·特朗普总统：要么有赢家，要么有输家。我们现在领先于中国和其他所有国家，我想保持这种状态。
麦克奎：特朗普已经取消了拜登时代的人工智能政策，并试图阻止各州制定自己的人工智能法律。然而，人们对日益强大的人工智能所带来的风险感到担忧。佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯（Bernie Sanders）是民主党党团会议的独立人士，他告诉 NPR，他计划明年推出多项人工智能法案。
伯尼·桑德斯：人们担心人工智能会抢走他们的工作，侵犯他们的隐私，影响他们孩子的心理健康，影响我们的民主基础。
麦克奎：桑德斯说他还希望禁止开发超级智能形式的人工智能。另一个问题是隐私。纽约民主党众议员伊维特·克拉克 (Yvette Clarke) 表示，她希望制定人工智能公司如何使用人们的数据的规则。
YVETTE CLARKE：我们面临的许多挑战是未经许可而以侵入性方式使用我们的数据。
麦克奎：她希望一些共和党人能够签署这些法案。
克拉克：我只是希望，当尘埃落定后，我们的另一边有足够多思想开放、公正的同事，让我们的努力能够得到两党的支持。
麦克奎：特朗普总统可以否决国会通过的任何法案。尽管桑德斯对特朗普作为领导人的适合性表示怀疑，但他乐观地认为，在人工智能安全问题上，特朗普仍然可以被说服。
桑德斯：他并不愚蠢，而且他实际上是一位优秀的政治家。而且他每天都改变主意。
麦克奎：桑德斯表示，公众希望人工智能得到保障，采取行动是国会的职责。

summary: Hatchlings emerge after discovery in September of first sea turtle nests ever to have been recorded on US west coast Two months after the discovery of the first sea turtle nests ever to have been recorded on the US west coast, the eggs have hatched – and Calif
summary_zh: 九月，美国西海岸首次发现海龟巢穴，两个月后，海龟幼龟开始出现。
body_en: Band of baby sea turtles swims out to sea after historic California nesting | California
Hatchlings emerge after discovery in September of first sea turtle nests ever to have been recorded on US west coast

Two months after the discovery of the first sea turtle nests ever to have been recorded on the US west coast, the eggs have hatched – and California’s first group of 75 native-born olive ridley sea turtles have been released into the Pacific.

The eggs incubated at the Aquarium of the Pacific in Long Beach after the historic discovery of two separate nests in September at southern California beaches, a shift likely driven by this year’s El Niño conditions.

On Saturday, the Aquarium of the Pacific announced the turtles’ first emergence in a social media post: “The hatchlings are here! We are excited to share that some of the olive ridley sea turtle eggs from Seal Beach successfully hatched after a 58-day incubation period. Working with our partners, we carefully released them from the beach in the dark early hours of this morning.”

A day later, the Aquarium added : “Even more egg-citing news! A second group of olive ridley sea turtle hatchlings, this time from the Huntington Beach nest, was released into the ocean early Sunday morning.”
In total, 54 turtles were released from the Seal Beach nest and 21 from the Huntington Beach nest.

On September 16, an olive ridley sea turtle was observed digging a nest and laying eggs on Seal Beach in the first-recorded instance of any sea turtle nesting on the west coast. Three days later, a second turtle was spotted nesting on Huntington Beach.
Typically a tropical species, the olive ridley sea turtle normally resides in the Pacific, Indian and Atlantic oceans, but has been known to nest on the southern tip of Baja California.

“It is not known why these turtles chose southern California beaches as nesting sites, but it indicates an important historical change that could have long-term implications for the species and for local sea turtle management and protection,” the Aquarium of the Pacific said in a social media post.

“The behavior of these turtles was probably influenced, at least in part, by the incoming El Niño, along with, the recent tropical storm, range expansion, or perhaps navigational mistakes. The species is also known for its behavioral flexibility.”

As Hurricane Polo began to form in late September, researchers with the aquarium and its federal and local partners relocated the 204 eggs from the two nests to incubate in the safety of the aquarium’s animal care facility.

“As animals adapt in unexpected ways to changes in their natural world, humans will need to adapt and make space to ensure endangered and threatened species are given a fighting chance,” said Jeff Flocken, president and CEO of the Aquarium of the Pacific.

“If they successfully hatch, these baby turtles will likely one day return to nest to carry on future generations on these very same beaches, giving us a remarkable opportunity to help a species expand its range and thrive.”

Even as the Huntington Beach and Seal Beach turtles have begun hatching and returned to the ocean, researchers are continuing to advise the public to be on the lookout for more nests. On 1 November, a third nest was recorded in Ventura county although those eggs were swept away by unusually high tides – likely also caused by El Niño.

九月份在美国西海岸发现了有史以来第一个海龟巢穴后，海龟幼龟出现了
在美国西海岸发现第一个海龟巢穴两个月后，海龟蛋已经孵化，首批 75 只加州本地出生的橄榄丽海龟已被释放到太平洋中。
九月份在南加州海滩历史性地发现了两个独立的巢穴后，这些卵在长滩太平洋水族馆孵化，这一变化可能是由今年的厄尔尼诺现象造成的。
周六，太平洋水族馆在社交媒体帖子中宣布了这些海龟的首次出现：“小海龟在这里！我们很高兴与大家分享，来自海豹海滩的一些丽丽海龟蛋经过 58 天的孵化期后成功孵化。我们与合作伙伴一起，在今天凌晨的黑暗中小心地将它们从海滩上放了出来。”
一天后，水族馆补充道：“还有更多关于鸡蛋的消息！第二批刚孵化的橄榄丽龟幼龟，这次是来自亨廷顿海滩的巢穴，于周日清晨被释放到海洋中。”
总共有 54 只海龟从海豹海滩巢穴中被释放，21 只海龟从亨廷顿海滩巢穴中被释放。
9 月 16 日，人们观察到一只橄榄丽海龟在海豹海滩筑巢并产卵，这是西海岸海龟筑巢的首次记录。三天后，人们发现第二只海龟在亨廷顿海滩筑巢。
橄榄丽龟是典型的热带物种，通常栖息在太平洋、印度洋和大西洋，但已知在下加利福尼亚州南端筑巢。
太平洋水族馆在社交媒体帖子中表示：“目前尚不清楚这些海龟为什么选择南加州海滩作为筑巢地，但这表明了一个重要的历史变化，可能对该物种以及当地海龟的管理和保护产生长期影响。”
“这些海龟的行为可能至少部分受到即将到来的厄尔尼诺现象以及最近的热带风暴、活动范围扩大或导航错误的影响。该物种还以其行为灵活性而闻名。”
随着飓风“波罗”于 9 月底开始形成，水族馆及其联邦和地方合作伙伴的研究人员将两个巢中的 204 个蛋转移到水族馆动物护理设施的安全区域中进行孵化。
太平洋水族馆总裁兼首席执行官杰夫·弗洛肯 (Jeff Flocken) 表示：“随着动物以意想不到的方式适应自然世界的变化，人类也需要适应并腾出空间，以确保濒临灭绝和受威胁的物种获得战斗的机会。”
“如果它们成功孵化，这些小海龟有一天可能会返回巢穴，在这些相同的海滩上繁衍后代，这为我们提供了一个绝佳的机会来帮助一个物种扩大其范围并繁衍生息。”
即使亨廷顿海滩和海豹海滩海龟已经开始孵化并返回海洋，研究人员仍继续建议公众寻找更多的海龟巢。 11 月 1 日，文图拉县发现了第三个巢，尽管这些蛋被异常涨潮（可能也是厄尔尼诺现象造成）冲走了。

body_en: Cause of death released for partner of Gypsy Rose Blanchard | Louisiana
Police investigation continues even as Louisiana coroner’s office releases findings on death of Kenan ‘Ken’ Urker
The cause of death of Gypsy Rose Blanchard’s partner, who died last month, has been released.

On Monday, the Lafourche parish coroner’s office in Louisiana determined that Kenan “Ken” Urker, 34, died from accidental polysubstance drug toxicity on 1 October, USA Today reports . The coroner’s office also said the case is complete.
However, law enforcement officials said that their investigation remains ongoing and is separate from the coroner’s inquiry.

“The Lafourche Parish Sheriff’s Office continues to investigate the circumstances surrounding the death of Kenan Urker. While we understand the Lafourche Parish Coroner’s Office has released updated information regarding the cause of death, our investigation is separate and remains ongoing. At this time, we have no additional information to release,” the sheriff’s office said.
Urker was found dead at his home on his 34th birthday last month after relatives requested a welfare check, according to the sheriff’s office.

In a police report, authorities said Urker was “cold to the touch” and “not breathing”. They added that officers at the scene were “able to see Mr Urker from the living room area lying on his back in [a] bed”.
Authorities also reported finding “paraphernalia (syringes and spoon) in the bathroom next to a brown powdery substance”.

Following Urker’s death, Blanchard, who served prison time for her role in her mother’s murder before being released in 2023, told People: “I don’t know if it was intentional or not … He was not in a good state of mind lately.”

Blanchard, who shares a nearly two-year-old daughter with Urker and first connected with him while she was in prison, also addressed the loss, saying: “There are no words that can express the depth of this loss. I ask for privacy and compassion for our daughter, our families, and everyone grieving Ken during this incredibly painful time.”
body_zh: 吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德 (Gypsy Rose Blanchard) 伴侣死因公布路易斯安那州
尽管路易斯安那州验尸官办公室发布了凯南·“肯”·厄克死亡的调查结果，但警方的调查仍在继续
吉普赛·罗斯·布兰查德上个月去世的伴侣的死因已经公布。
据《今日美国》报道，周一，路易斯安那州拉福什教区验尸官办公室确定，34 岁的凯南·“肯”·厄克 (Kenan “Ken” Urker) 于 10 月 1 日死于多物质药物意外中毒。验尸官办公室还表示，案件已经完成。
然而，执法官员表示，他们的调查仍在进行中，并且与验尸官的调查是分开的。
“拉富什教区治安官办公室继续调查凯南·厄克死亡的情况。虽然我们了解到拉富什教区验尸官办公室已经发布了有关死因的最新信息，但我们的调查是单独的，并且仍在进行中。目前，我们没有更多信息可以发布，”治安官办公室表示。
据治安官办公室称，上个月，在他 34 岁生日那天，在亲戚要求进行福利检查后，乌克被发现在家中死亡。
在一份警方报告中，当局称厄克“摸起来很冷”并且“没有呼吸”。他们补充说，现场的警察“能够从客厅看到厄克先生仰面躺在床上”。
当局还报告称，“在浴室里发现了棕色粉末状物质旁边的用具（注射器和勺子）”。
乌克死后，布兰查德因参与谋杀母亲而入狱，并于 2023 年出狱。她告诉《人物》杂志：“我不知道这是有意还是无意……他最近精神状态不佳。”
布兰查德与厄克有一个近两岁的女儿，第一次与他联系是在她入狱期间。布兰查德也谈到了这一损失，他说：“没有任何言语可以表达这种损失的深度。我请求我们的女儿、我们的家人以及在这个极其痛苦的时刻为肯悲伤的每个人提供隐私和同情。”

title_en: Big wave surfers line up to ride ‘raw power of the Pacific’ during Super El-Niño swells
title_zh: 超级厄尔尼诺现象期间，巨浪冲浪者排队享受“太平洋的原始力量”
summary: Fans of the sport dubbed the event ‘Monster Day’ as pro surfers tackled the storm-driven waves at Mavericks Beach While this year’s Super El Niño storms are battering the California coast and destroying homes and infrastructure, surfers are finding a silver li
summary_zh: 这项运动的粉丝将这一活动称为“怪物日”，因为职业冲浪者在小牛海滩应对风暴驱动的海浪，而今年的超级厄尔尼诺现象
body_en: Big wave surfers line up to ride ‘raw power of the Pacific’ during Super El-Niño swells | California
Fans of the sport dubbed the event ‘Monster Day’ as pro surfers tackled the storm-driven waves at Mavericks Beach

While this year’s Super El Niño storms are battering the California coast and destroying homes and infrastructure, surfers are finding a silver lining: waves so epic that pro athletes from around the world are making last-minute journeys to experience them.
Big wave surfers converged on northern California this Saturday to ride massive, storm-driven swells at the famously dangerous Mavericks Beach, an event some surf fans called “Monster Day.”

Kai Lenny, an American pro surfer, Clément Roseyro, a French big wave surfer, Jamie Mitchell, an Australian big wave surfer, Lucas “Chumbo” Chianca, a Brazilian pro surfer, and Luca Padua, a local star surfer who is from Half Moon Bay, were among those who risked the waves this weekend.

Lai wrote on Instagram that he “nearly didn’t make it” to Mavericks over the weekend after “all flights were grounded nationwide”, but that he was one of the lucky few to make it to San Francisco, which is just 20 miles north of Mavericks, near Half Moon Bay, California. Justine Dupont, a French pro surfer, wrote on social media that she had been heading to Mavericks, but was “locked in the Boston airport”, the Washington Post reported .

The conditions on Saturday were so rough that even some experienced big wave surfers decided not to risk it: “If the waves are 60ft and you’re not feeling 100%, the stakes are just way too high,” Bianca Valenti, an American pro surfer who has surfed Mavericks many times, said in a social media post.
Surfer Ridge Lenny, Kai’s brother, called the day “very wild” and “frankly terrifying”, in an Instagram post.
Others described the Mavericks El Niño surf as “no joke” and “survival mode”.

Mitchell, the Australian big wave surfer, found himself crushed by one of the waves on Saturday, and though he triggered his inflatable safety vest, the power of the ocean was so strong that the vest “ripped off”, photographer Fred Pompermayer wrote on Instagram. “This is the raw power of the Pacific.”

“The waves were breaking in areas that they almost never break in … You’re talking six, seven stories-plus,” Grant Washburn, a longtime local surfer, who watched the action at Mavericks, told the San Francisco Chronicle .
It “took all my years of experience to survive that”, Mitchell wrote on Instagram.
But some of those who risked the six-story waves, such as Lenny, produced jaw-dropping footage of their exploits.
“Well hello El Niño ... it’s good to see you,” surf filmmaker Tucker Wooding wrote.
body_zh: Big wave surfers line up to ride ‘raw power of the Pacific’ during Super El-Niño swells |加利福尼亚州
当职业冲浪者在小牛海滩应对风暴带来的海浪时，这项运动的粉丝们将这一活动称为“怪物日”
虽然今年的超级厄尔尼诺风暴袭击了加州海岸，摧毁了房屋和基础设施，但冲浪者却发现了一线希望：海浪如此巨大，以至于来自世界各地的职业运动员都在最后一刻赶赴体验它们。
本周六，大浪冲浪者聚集在加利福尼亚州北部，在以危险着称的 Mavericks 海滩上冲浪，体验由风暴驱动的巨浪，一些冲浪爱好者将这一活动称为“怪物日”。
美国职业冲浪运动员凯·莱尼 (Kai Lenny)、法国大浪冲浪运动员克莱门特·罗塞罗 (Clément Roseyro)、澳大利亚大浪冲浪运动员杰米·米切尔 (Jamie Mitchell)、巴西职业冲浪运动员卢卡斯·“Chumbo”·奇安卡 (Lucas “Chumbo” Chianca) 和来自半月湾的当地明星冲浪运动员卢卡·帕多瓦 (Luca Padua) 都是本周末冒险冲浪的人之一。
赖在 Instagram 上写道，周末“全国所有航班均停飞”后，他“差点没能抵达”小牛队，但他是少数能够抵达旧金山的幸运儿之一，旧金山位于小牛队以北 20 英里处，靠近加利福尼亚州半月湾。据《华盛顿邮报》报道，法国职业冲浪运动员贾斯汀·杜邦在社交媒体上写道，她本来打算前往小牛队，但“被锁在波士顿机场”。
周六的情况非常恶劣，就连一些经验丰富的大浪冲浪者也决定不冒险：“如果海浪有 60 英尺，而你感觉不到 100%，那么风险就太高了，”曾多次在 Mavericks 冲浪的美国职业冲浪运动员比安卡·瓦伦蒂 (Bianca Valenti) 在社交媒体帖子中表示。
凯的兄弟冲浪者岭莱尼 (Surfer Ridge Lenny) 在 Instagram 上发帖称这一天“非常狂野”且“坦白说很可怕”。
其他人将小牛队的厄尔尼诺冲浪描述为“不是开玩笑”和“生存模式”。
摄影师 Fred Pompermayer 在 Instagram 上写道，周六，澳大利亚大浪冲浪运动员米切尔 (Mitchell) 发现自己被一处海浪压倒，尽管他触发了充气安全背心，但海洋的力量如此强大，以至于背心“被扯掉了”。 “这就是太平洋的原始力量。”
“海浪正在冲破他们几乎从未冲破的区域……你说的是六、七层楼以上，”长期观看小牛队比赛的当地冲浪者格兰特·沃什伯恩 (Grant Washburn) 告诉《旧金山纪事报》。
米切尔在 Instagram 上写道，“我凭借多年的经验才得以幸存”。
但一些冒着六层楼高浪风险的人，比如莱尼，拍摄了令人瞠目结舌的镜头记录了他们的冒险经历。
“你好，厄尔尼诺现象……很高兴见到你，”冲浪电影制片人塔克·伍丁写道。

body_en: California braces for more towering waves as powerful storms approach | California
NWS issues advisories for long stretches of the northern California coast, warning that waves can quickly overpower anyone nearby
The massive, 50-ft swells along California’s coast this weekend foretold an intense week of towering waves to come.

Officials from the National Weather Service (NWS) had issued advisories for long stretches of the California coast, warning people that erratic and unpredictable waves could quickly overpower anyone nearby. The highest waves – which reached 50ft to 60ft (15.24 to 18.29 meters) – cracked along the popular Mavericks surf spot in San Mateo county, south of San Francisco .

In the coming days, officials said weather models are predicting more storms, this time coming from a more westerly direction that could expose slightly different parts of the coast to monster waves – which could peak around 20ft (6.1 meters).

High surf and coastal flood advisories were in effect throughout the weekend, and about 270 homes in Santa Cruz county were under evacuation warnings. Meanwhile on Monday, a local spotted two waterspouts emerging from the San Francisco Bay – shocking residents. Officials said these spouts did not move offshore or cause any damage.
Even more rain and high surf are expected to follow. “It’s going to be a busy couple of weeks – be ready,” said Brian Garcia, a meteorologist from the NWS.

The low-pressure system that brought rain across the Bay Area on Sunday will be followed by large waves on Monday night. Rare tornado warnings were in effect for parts of Santa Cruz county through Monday afternoon.

Midweek, a powerful storm building along the Pacific is expected to bring between 1.5in and 6in (3.81cm to 15.24cm) of rain across the Bay Area as well as fierce winds of up to 50 miles per hour (80.46 km/h).

Huge waves usually accompany a strong El Niño – and this year’s is predicted to be the strongest ever recorded, with global implications. El Niños are a naturally recurring phenomenon where the eastern Pacific temporarily heats up, causing global changes in weather patterns. Some research suggests that global heating is making El Ninõs more powerful. Scientists have also warned that the current, record-setting El Niño will be a “risk multiplier” – warping global weather patterns that have fueled wildfires and crop failures in Indonesia, coastal inundation in the US , severe drought in Sudan, and severe flooding in several countries.
In California, officials are expecting coastal wells, but also more intense storms and erratic weather through the next several months.

This week, the two Pacific storms are expected to impact not only the coast but huge swathes of the eastern US, bringing gusty winds, rain and heavy mountain snow in the Sierra Nevadas, according to NWS.
body_zh: 随着强大风暴的临近，加州准备迎接更多巨浪加利福尼亚州
国家气象局针对加州北部海岸的长段地区发布警告，警告海浪可能很快淹没附近的任何人
本周末，加州海岸出现 50 英尺高的巨浪，预示着接下来的一周将会出现巨浪。
美国国家气象局 (NWS) 的官员已针对加州海岸线的大部分地区发布了警告，警告人们不稳定且不可预测的海浪可能会很快淹没附近的任何人。最高的海浪高达 50 英尺至 60 英尺（15.24 至 18.29 米），沿着旧金山南部圣马特奥县的小牛队冲浪点破裂。
官员们表示，未来几天，天气模型预计会有更多风暴，这次风暴来自更西的方向，可能会使海岸的不同部分遭受巨浪袭击，峰值可能达到 20 英尺（6.1 米）左右。
周末期间，高浪和沿海洪水警报一直有效，圣克鲁斯县约 270 户家庭收到疏散警告。与此同时，周一，当地人发现旧金山湾出现两道水龙卷，令居民震惊。官员们表示，这些喷口并未移至近海或造成任何损害。
预计接下来还会有更多的降雨和海浪。 “这将是忙碌的几周——做好准备，”国家气象局的气象学家布莱恩·加西亚说。
周日低压系统给湾区带来了降雨，周一晚上将出现大浪。截至周一下午，罕见的龙卷风警告仍在圣克鲁斯县部分地区生效。
周中，太平洋沿岸的一场强大风暴预计将为湾区带来 1.5 英寸至 6 英寸（3.81 厘米至 15.24 厘米）的降雨，以及时速高达 50 英里（80.46 公里/小时）的强风。

强烈的厄尔尼诺现象通常会伴随着巨大的波浪，而今年的厄尔尼诺现象预计将是有记录以来最强的一次，具有全球影响。厄尔尼诺现象是一种自然反复发生的现象，东太平洋暂时升温，导致全球天气模式发生变化。一些研究表明，全球变暖正在使厄尔尼诺现象变得更加强大。科学家还警告说，目前创纪录的厄尔尼诺现象将成为“风险倍增器”——扭曲全球天气模式，加剧印度尼西亚的野火和农作物歉收、美国沿海洪水、苏丹严重干旱以及多个国家的严重洪水。
在加利福尼亚州，官员们预计未来几个月沿海水井将会出现，但风暴和不稳定的天气也会更加强烈。
据国家气象局报道，本周两场太平洋风暴预计不仅会影响海岸，还会影响美国东部大片地区，给内华达山脉带来阵风、降雨和大雪。

body_en: Trump meets with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout : NPR

Trump meets with Xi and Putin amid Nvidia fallout The trip to China marks Trump's second time this year, and comes as the president and his party faced widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections.
U.S. President Trump attends a ceremony in honor of Veterans Day at Arlington National Cemetery on Nov. 11 in Arlington, Va. Kevin Dietsch/Getty Images hide caption
President Trump heads to Asia this week where he's set to meet with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin for a high-stakes trilateral summit.

The trip to China marks Trump's second visit this year, and comes as the president and his party face widespread backlash from voters in the recent midterm elections, potentially weakening his bargaining position across the Pacific.

The president and administration officials – including Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick – are also under scrutiny after the recent resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang , who admitted to an extramarital affair with a woman who U.S. intelligence officials believe was recruited by China's top spy agency, according to The New York Times. NPR has not independently confirmed those reports.
Huang traveled to China with Trump earlier this year – this time, tech billionaire Elon Musk is joining Trump in Shenzhen.

The expectation for major deals or pronouncements coming out of the meetings this week are low – but the meeting is still expected to make waves over the imagery of the trilateral summit. Trump said as he left the White House Monday that he may also meet with North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.
Before China, Trump will first travel to the Philippines where he'll meet with allies at the ASEAN summit in Manila.
The president is expected to be in the region for just about three days.

For weeks the president has said he's keen to discuss the Iran war and denuclearization with Putin and Xi. But Edgard Kagan, the former ambassador to Malaysia and a senior adviser at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, said it's a topic that Xi likely won't want to get into. The White House confirmed Friday that Trump is expected to meet with Xi and Putin together.
"The Chinese strongly disagree with the idea that they should be involved in any kind of trilateral discussions with the United States and Russia on nuclear weapons," Kagan said.

"China wants to avoid this because they don't want to be locked into a subservient position. And they also don't want to create a precedent. I think the main thing for the Chinese is they know if they do a meeting and nuclear issues are discussed, it becomes much harder for them to refuse to do it in the future," he said.
A White House official said they do not expect any agreement to come out of the meeting on denuclearization.
"We do not expect to get to any kind of agreement," the official said, calling the trilateral an "entry point" for the three countries to talk about reducing nuclear weapons stock.
Another U.S. official not authorized to speak on the record acknowledged that denuclearization is a "difficult" topic for China.
"But we do think it's time for China to sort of step up to the adult table, if you will, and have adult conversations about adult things," the official said.

Putin, for his part, stands to benefit from a meeting with Trump and Xi, as Russia's war with Ukraine nears its five-year mark. Trump has made friendlier moves toward Russia in recent months, siding with Putin and striking a deal to release more Russian oil into the market ahead of the midterm elections.
Trump said last month that he was fine with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy not being present at a potential meeting with Putin about the war.

此次中国之行是特朗普今年的第二次访问，正值总统及其政党在最近的中期选举中面临选民的广泛强烈反对，这可能会削弱他在太平洋彼岸的讨价还价地位。
据《纽约时报》报道，英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋最近辞职后，总统和政府官员 - 包括商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克 - 也受到审查，黄仁勋承认与一名美国情报官员认为是由中国最高间谍机构招募的女性发生婚外情。 NPR 尚未独立证实这些报道。
黄今年早些时候与特朗普一起访问了中国——这一次，科技亿万富翁埃隆·马斯克将与特朗普一起前往深圳。
对本周会议达成的重大协议或声明的预期较低，但会议仍有望对三边峰会的形象产生影响。特朗普周一离开白宫时表示，他也可能会见朝鲜领导人金正恩。
在中国之前，特朗普将首先前往菲律宾，并在马尼拉举行的东盟峰会上与盟友会面。
预计总统将在该地区停留大约三天。
几周来，总统一直表示他热衷于与普京和习近平讨论伊朗战争和无核化问题。但前驻马来西亚大使、战略与国际研究中心高级顾问埃德加德·卡根表示，习近平可能不想讨论这个话题。白宫周五证实，特朗普预计将与习近平和普京一起会面。
卡根说：“中国强烈反对他们应该参与与美国和俄罗斯就核武器问题进行任何形式的三边讨论。”
“中国希望避免这种情况，因为他们不想陷入屈从的地位。他们也不想开创先例。我认为对中国人来说最重要的是他们知道如果他们举行会议并讨论核问题，他们将来就很难拒绝这样做，”他说。
一名白宫官员表示，他们预计此次会议不会就无核化问题达成任何协议。
这位官员表示：“我们预计不会达成任何形式的协议。”他称三边会谈是三个国家讨论削减核武器库存的“切入点”。
另一位未获授权公开发言的美国官员承认，无核化对中国来说是一个“困难”的话题。
这位官员表示：“但我们确实认为，如果你愿意的话，中国现在是时候站到成人的餐桌上，就成人的事情进行成人对话了。”
就普京而言，随着俄罗斯与乌克兰的战争接近五年，他将从与特朗普和习近平的会晤中受益。近几个月来，特朗普对俄罗斯采取了更加友好的举措，与普京站在一起，并达成协议，在中期选举前向市场释放更多俄罗斯石油。
特朗普上个月表示，他同意乌克兰总统泽连斯基不出席与普京就战争问题举行的可能会面。

title_zh: 美国联合航空公司表示正在努力解决“广泛”的系统中断问题
summary: Outage at major airline comes just three days after FAA issued rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights United ⁠Airlines said on ⁠Monday ⁠that it was ​experiencing ⁠a widespread system ⁠outage, just three days after the Federal ⁠Aviation Administration is

body_en: United Airlines says ‘widespread’ system outage resolved | US news
United Airlines says ‘widespread’ system outage resolved
Airline acknowledges ‘technology issue that delayed flight departures’ in latest high-profile outage to affect Americans
United ⁠Airlines said on ⁠Monday ⁠that it had resolved ⁠a widespread system ⁠outage, just three days after the Federal ⁠Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights.

“We have resolved a technology issue that delayed flight departures. While some flights were delayed, there was no impact on flights in progress, or on United Express flights,” United said in a statement. “There is no indication that this was a cybersecurity-related issue.”

According to an internal memo from ​United’s pilots’ ‌union seen ‌by Reuters, a company-wide ‌web-based outage had affected multiple applications used by pilots, including crew communications. It said United was unable to provide final ‌aircraft weights for departing flights and advised pilots to ​follow airport station guidance on whether to leave their gates.

The United computer issue is just the latest high-profile technology meltdown to affect Americans in the last few days. On Friday, ageing equipment led to a temporary grounding of all commercial airplanes in the US for more than four hours, sparking travel chaos as thousands of flights were delayed or canceled.
The Trump administration said the rare ground stop stemmed from a fiber upgrade during routine maintenance that led to data flooding, which crashed a critical communication system.

And earlier on Monday, customers reported service outages and difficulty accessing their online accounts at several major US banks and the money transfer service Zelle after a technical issue at JPMorgan Chase caused ripple effects throughout the financial system.

It also comes after a major outage by Microsoft that began on Thursday and lasted into the next day, which crippled a host of services including Outlook, Teams and AI assistant Copilot. The outage had serious repercussions for millions of people and organizations all over the world, including schools, hospitals, businesses, courts, banks, prisons, police forces and governments.

Microsoft said it had resolved the issue and restored service by Saturday, also issuing an apology. The office software giant did not attribute the blackout to a cybersecurity breach, identifying in an initial report on Monday that a combination of a months-old bug, malfunctioning internal connections, and server capacity sparked the outage.
body_zh: 联合航空表示“广泛”的系统中断已得到解决美国新闻
联合航空表示“广泛”的系统中断已得到解决
航空公司承认在最近一次影响美国人的高调停电中存在“技术问题导致航班起飞延迟”
联合航空周一表示，在联邦航空管理局对所有美国航班罕见地在全国范围内停飞的三天后，它已经解决了大范围的系统中断问题。
美联航在一份声明中表示：“我们已经解决了导致航班起飞延误的技术问题。虽然部分航班延误，但对正在进行的航班或联航快运航班没有影响。” “没有迹象表明这是与网络安全相关的问题。”
根据路透社看到的美联航飞行员工会的一份内部备忘录，全公司范围内的网络中断影响了飞行员使用的多个应用程序，包括机组人员通信。该公司表示，美联航无法提供离港航班的最终飞机重量，并建议飞行员遵循机场站的指导来决定是否离开登机口。
美联航电脑问题只是过去几天影响美国人的最新一起备受瞩目的技术崩溃事件。周五，设备老化导致美国所有商用飞机暂时停飞四个多小时，数千航班延误或取消，引发旅行混乱。
特朗普政府表示，这次罕见的停飞事件是由于例行维护期间的光纤升级导致数据泛滥，导致关键通信系统崩溃。
周一早些时候，客户报告称，在摩根大通的技术问题对整个金融系统造成连锁反应后，美国几家主要银行和汇款服务商 Zelle 的服务出现中断，并且难以访问其在线账户。
此前，微软从周四开始一直持续到第二天，导致包括 Outlook、Teams 和 AI 助手 Copilot 在内的一系列服务瘫痪。这次停电对世界各地数百万人和组织造成了严重影响，包括学校、医院、企业、法院、银行、监狱、警察部队和政府。
微软表示已解决该问题并于周六恢复服务，并发表了道歉声明。这家办公软件巨头并未将此次停电归因于网络安全漏洞，而是在周一的一份初步报告中指出，几个月前的错误、内部连接故障和服务器容量共同引发了此次停电。

title_en: An early look at the 2028 Senate map: From the Politics Desk
title_zh: 2028 年参议院地图初览：来自政治部门
summary: In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur dives into the next battle for the Senate.
summary_zh: 在今天的版本中，萨希尔·卡普尔（Sahil Kapur）深入探讨了下一场参议院之战。
body_en: Scott Colom says he notched his upset victory ‘the Mississippi way’: Full interview
In today’s edition, Sahil Kapur dives into the next battle for the Senate. Plus, Megan Brand explores how Black voters fueled the inroads Democrats made this year in the South.
In one election night, Democrats turned a deep structural disadvantage in the Senate into an upper hand heading into the next presidential cycle.

After Republicans entered the year as favorites to maintain control, Democrats are now on pace to gain nine seats, with NBC News Decision Desk characterizing the Alaska Senate race as a likely victory for former Rep. Mary Pelotla . That would give the party a 56-44 majority, which would be the largest since 2009.
It also means the GOP would need to pick up at least six seats to flip control of the chamber in 2028 (and seven if they don’t control the vice presidency).

Core battleground: There are six states that were decided by single digits in the last three presidential elections. That includes four Democratic-held seats in Arizona ( Mark Kelly ), Nevada ( Catherine Cortez Masto ), Georgia ( Raphael Warnock ) and Pennsylvania ( John Fetterman ).
Republicans will need to capture all four of those seats to give themselves a realistic shot at the majority in 2028.

Of the four Democrats, Fetterman faces the greatest danger of getting a primary challenger after his popularity with Democrats has plummeted. Kelly and Warnock are in the early 2028 presidential conversation; they’ll both have an important decision to make about whether to seek re-election or make a run for the White House.
There are also two Republican-held seats in this category: Wisconsin ( Ron Johnson ) and North Carolina ( Ted Budd ).
Johnson survived in 2022 by just 1 point while Budd won by 3 points in a midterm year in which Democrats were on the receiving end of backlash from voters with Joe Biden in the White House.
Extended battleground, red-state edition: There are six states President Donald Trump carried by double digits two years ago that became highly competitive in 2026.

The first is Ohio , which Trump won by 11 points in 2024 and Democrat Sherrod Brown won by 5 points this year. Brown’s victory was a special election, so the seat is up again in 2028. It will mark the only double-digit Trump state represented by a Democrat in the next cycle.

The others include four Republican-held states where the other Senate seat flipped from red to blue this year: Iowa ( Chuck Grassley ), Kansas ( Jerry Moran ), South Carolina ( Tim Scott ) and, assuming Democrats officially prevail, Alaska ( Lisa Murkowski ).

Rounding out the list is Florida , where GOP Sen. Ashley Moody defeated underfunded progressive Democrat Angie Nixon by less than 3 points. Like Ohio, this was a special election, so Moody will have to run again in two years.

Can lightning strike twice? Democrats needed a dream environment (and, in some cases, weak GOP candidates) to make those states competitive in 2026. It’s far from clear they can replicate that in two years. But if they can, a filibuster-proof majority of 60 seats could be within reach for Democrats.

Extended battleground, blue-state edition: If Republicans sweep every red and purple state mentioned above, they’ll have picked up five Democratic-held seats, needing at least one more to capture Senate control. That’s where blue-leaning territory comes into focus.
Judging by recent presidential elections, New Hampshire ( Maggie Hassan ) is probably the GOP’s best chance.

From there the hill gets much steeper, with seats up in the solidly Democratic states of California , Colorado , Connecticut, Hawaii , Illinois , Maryland , New York , Oregon , Vermont and Washington .

How difficult are those states? In 2022, Republicans zeroed in on Colorado and Washington as sleeper races after recruiting who they viewed as strong candidates. They ultimately lost both by double digits.

It’s almost a mirror image of the rough environment Democrats faced entering 2026 — they needed to win at least two solidly red states to have a shot at Senate control. Now it’s Republicans who would need to win at least one blue state to give themselves a chance.
body_zh: 斯科特·科洛姆表示，他以“密西西比方式”取得了令人沮丧的胜利：完整采访
在今天的版本中，萨希尔·卡普尔（Sahil Kapur）深入探讨了下一场参议院之战。此外，梅根·布兰德探讨了黑人选民如何推动民主党今年在南方取得的进展。
在一个选举之夜，民主党将参议院的严重结构性劣势转变为进入下一总统周期的优势。
在共和党进入今年以来成为保持控制权的热门人选后，民主党现在有望获得 9 个席位，NBC 新闻决策台将阿拉斯加州参议员竞选描述为前众议员玛丽·佩洛特拉 (Mary Pelotla) 可能获胜。这将使该党获得 56 比 44 的多数席位，这将是 2009 年以来的最大席位。
这也意味着共和党需要在 2028 年赢得至少 6 个席位才能推翻众议院的控制权（如果他们不控制副总统职位，则需要获得 7 个席位）。
核心战场：过去三届总统选举中，有六个州以个位数决定胜负。其中包括民主党在亚利桑那州（马克·凯利）、内华达州（凯瑟琳·科尔特斯·马斯托）、佐治亚州（拉斐尔·沃诺克）和宾夕法尼亚州（约翰·费特曼）占据的四个席位。
共和党需要夺取所有四个席位，才能在 2028 年获得多数席位。
在四名民主党人中，费特曼在民主党的支持率大幅下降后，面临着成为初选挑战者的最大危险。凯利和沃诺克正在讨论 2028 年初的总统大选；他们都将面临一个重要决定：是寻求连任还是竞选白宫。
此类别中还有两个共和党席位：威斯康星州（罗恩·约翰逊）和北卡罗来纳州（特德·巴德）。
约翰逊在 2022 年仅以 1 个百分点的优势幸存，而巴德在中期选举中以 3 个百分点的优势获胜，当时民主党在乔·拜登入主白宫时遭到了选民的强烈反对。
扩展战场，红色州版：两年前唐纳德·特朗普总统的支持率达到两位数的六个州在 2026 年变得极具竞争力。
首先是俄亥俄州，特朗普在2024年以11个百分点获胜，民主党人谢罗德·布朗今年以5个百分点获胜。布朗的胜利是一次特别选举，因此该席位将在2028年再次增加。这将标志着下一个周期中唯一一个由民主党代表的特朗普人数达到两位数的州。
其他州包括四个共和党控制的州，今年另一个参议院席位从红色变为蓝色：爱荷华州（查克·格拉斯利）、堪萨斯州（杰里·莫兰）、南卡罗来纳州（蒂姆·斯科特），以及假设民主党正式获胜的阿拉斯加州（丽莎·默科斯基）。
排在最后的是佛罗里达州，共和党参议员阿什利·穆迪 (Ashley Moody) 以不到 3 个百分点的优势击败了资金不足的进步民主党人安吉·尼克松 (Angie Nixon)。与俄亥俄州一样，这是一次特别选举，因此穆迪必须在两年后再次竞选。
闪电可以击中两次吗民主党需要一个理想的环境（在某些情况下还需要弱势的共和党候选人）才能使这些州在 2026 年具有竞争力。目前还不清楚他们能否在两年内复制这一点。但如果可以的话，民主党就有可能获得 60 个席位中的多数席位。
扩展战场，蓝州版本：如果共和党横扫上述每个红色和紫色州，他们将获得民主党控制的五个席位，至少还需要一个席位才能夺取参议院控制权。这就是偏蓝地区成为焦点的地方。
从最近的总统选举来看，新罕布什尔州（玛吉·哈桑饰）可能是共和党最好的机会。
从那里开始，山变得更加陡峭，在加利福尼亚州、科罗拉多州、康涅狄格州、夏威夷州、伊利诺伊州、马里兰州、纽约州、俄勒冈州、佛蒙特州和华盛顿州等坚定的民主党州，席位都增加了。
这些州有多难？ 2022 年，共和党在招募了他们认为强有力的候选人后，将科罗拉多州和华盛顿州作为卧铺竞选的目标。最终他们都以两位数的优势落败。
这几乎是民主党在进入 2026 年时面临的严峻环境的镜像——他们需要赢得至少两个绝对红色的州才能获得参议院控制权。现在，共和党人需要赢得至少一个蓝州才能给自己一个机会。

title_en: Freeman Johnson, oldest survivor of Pearl Harbor attack, dies aged 106
title_zh: 珍珠港袭击最年长幸存者弗里曼·约翰逊去世，享年 106 岁
summary: Johnson was working on the USS St Louis and was inside a steam drum when the attacks took place The oldest known survivor of the Pearl Harbor attack died Saturday aged 106 years old. Freeman Johnson, a fireman below the deck during the attack, died in his home
summary_zh: 袭击事件发生时，约翰逊正在圣路易斯号航空母舰上工作，他正在蒸汽鼓内。 珍珠港袭击事件中已知最年长的幸存者
body_en: Johnson was working on the USS St Louis and was inside a steam drum when the attacks took place

The oldest known survivor of the Pearl Harbor attack died Saturday aged 106 years old. Freeman Johnson, a fireman below the deck during the attack, died in his home in Massachusetts, according to the Boston Globe .
Only 11 known Pearl Harbor survivors are still living, all of whom are centenarians.
At 21 years old, Johnson said, he never saw the attacks from the Japanese fighters that Sunday morning in Hawaii on 7 December 1941.

He worked on the USS St Louis, which was his first deployment after basic training. It was the only major ship that left the attack “unscathed”, according to the Pentagon . The ship graced the nickname “Lucky Lou”.
“While all the rigamarole was going on topside, I was inside a steam drum. Couldn’t see anything, absolutely nothing,” Johnson told the Associated Press in May.
Johnson heard machine guns and felt vibrations while he was reading that morning.
“That was the first sign we knew something was wrong,” he told the Boston Globe in 2018 .
He was tasked with fixing parts of the ship’s boilers as another member of the crew passed the boiler’s pieces to Johnson.
Johnson said, however, that his work during Pearl Harbor didn’t make him heroic, nor was it a source of his pride.
“I wasn’t brave, I was there,” he said last year in a Pacific Historic Parks interview . “I just did what I was told. I did my job.”
His pride, instead, came when he married his late wife Ruth Hills in 1950. They went on to have three daughters, served as foster parents to several others and eventually had two grandchildren.

After leaving the navy, he worked several jobs including at a machine shop for 40 years, a convenience store and delivering meals to seniors. He formally retired at 90 and eventually lived with his daughter Diane Johnson until he died.
“It’s going to be a hell of a Thanksgiving,” Diane Johnson told the Associated Press. “He’s going to be up there with all of his friends and family and my mom.”
body_zh: 袭击发生时，约翰逊正在圣路易斯号航空母舰上工作，他正在蒸汽鼓内
已知最年长的珍珠港袭击幸存者于周六去世，享年 106 岁。据《波士顿环球报》报道，袭击中甲板下的消防员弗里曼·约翰逊在马萨诸塞州的家中死亡。
目前已知的珍珠港事件幸存者仅剩 11 名，他们都是百岁老人。
约翰逊说，21 岁时，他从未亲眼目睹过 1941 年 12 月 7 日周日早上在夏威夷发生的日本战斗机的袭击。
他在圣路易斯号航空母舰上工作，这是他在基础训练后的首次部署。据五角大楼称，这是唯一一艘在袭击中“毫发无损”的大型舰艇。这艘船被昵称为“Lucky Lou”。
“当所有的通心粉都在顶部进行时，我却在蒸汽鼓内。什么也看不见，绝对什么都没有，”约翰逊五月份告诉美联社。
那天早上，约翰逊在读书时听到了机枪声并感到了震动。
“这是我们知道出了问题的第一个迹象，”他在 2018 年告诉《波士顿环球报》。
当另一名船员将锅炉部件交给约翰逊时，他的任务是修理船上锅炉的部件。
然而，约翰逊表示，珍珠港事件期间的工作并没有让他成为英雄，也不是他骄傲的源泉。
“我并不勇敢，但我就在那里，”他去年在太平洋历史公园采访时说道。 “我只是按照别人告诉我的去做。我做了我的工作。”
相反，当他于 1950 年与已故的妻子露丝·希尔斯 (Ruth Hills) 结婚时，他的骄傲就出现了。他们后来生了三个女儿，成为其他几个女儿的养父母，并最终有了两个孙子。
离开海军后，他做过几份工作，包括在机械车间工作了 40 年、在便利店工作以及为老年人送餐。他在 90 岁时正式退休，最终与女儿黛安·约翰逊 (Diane Johnson) 一起生活直至去世。
“这将是一个地狱般的感恩节，”黛安·约翰逊告诉美联社。 “他将和他所有的朋友、家人以及我妈妈一起在那里。”
